# ResumeTimer

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [System](BlitzPlus-System)

```blitzbasic
ResumeTimer timer%
```

**Works in:** BlitzPlus

Lets a timer paused with [PauseTimer](PauseTimer) tick again.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Timer", 20, 20, 240, 100, Desktop(), 3)
tm = CreateTimer(2)
PauseTimer tm
ResumeTimer tm
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent()
	If e = $4001 Then SetGadgetText win, "Tick " + EventData()
Until e = $803
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `timer` | Int | required | A timer from `CreateTimer`. |
